editorial:
Imagine waking up on your sixteenth birthday to find your mom has vanished, leaving you with a few hidden clues and a very strict older brother. You get to step into the shoes of Enola, Sherlock Holmes' younger sister, who is just as smart and curious as he is. The vibe here is bright, energetic, and full of spirit. Instead of a gloomy London, you get a colorful adventure where a rebellious teen breaks all the rules of the time to find her family. It feels like a breath of fresh air because Enola talks directly to you, making you feel like you are part of her secret mission.

Millie Bobby Brown is fantastic and carries the whole movie with her charm. The pacing is quick, and the fight scenes are choreographed like a dance, which keeps things exciting. While some might find the plot a bit simple, it is mostly just a fun ride. If you want the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Netflix to see all the beautiful costumes and sets. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is a great move. It is a perfect pick for a family movie night.
endingExplained: Enola discovers that her mother left her to escape a controlling life and to help her daughter find her own path. While trying to save a young Lord, Enola stops a plot to change the laws of England. She proves she is just as good a detective as Sherlock. In the end, she decides not to go to a finishing school and chooses to live her own life as an independent sleuth in London.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a lighthearted mystery and strong lead characters.
